# `DiagnosticLines`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\DiagnosticLines`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/DiagnosticLines.php#L30) — **Version:** working tree

The lines an adapter prints after a property run, worded once for every
adapter: the excessive-discard warning, the discarded-examples warning, the
[`Classify`](/api/classes/Classify) distribution, one line per
`Classify::tabulate()` table, what exhaustive mode did, and the targeted
search report — in that order, so two adapters writing into one log print
the same lines in the same order. The engine still never prints: the
adapter decides where each DiagnosticLevel goes.

```php
$statistics = RunStatistics::of($result);

if ($statistics !== null) {
    foreach (DiagnosticLines::of($name, $statistics) as $line) {
        fwrite($line->level === DiagnosticLevel::Warning ? STDERR : STDOUT, $line->text . "\n");
    }
}
```

|---|---|---|---|
| `SKIP_RATE_WARNING_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.9` | More than this share of discarded attempts is worth a warning. |

## Methods

### of()

```php
static of(string $name, \Runner\RunStatistics $statistics): array
```

The lines for one run, in print order; empty when there is nothing to say.

- `$name` — The property's display name, as the messages quote it.
- `$statistics` — What the run counted ([`Runner\RunStatistics`](/api/classes/Runner/RunStatistics)::of()).
